topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines its learning objectives regarding cancer treatments.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address foundational cancer treatment modalities, detailing the use of surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy alongside mechanisms of drug action and resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting cancer cell vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities, including hormone receptor dependency, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine targeted therapy driven by oncogene addiction, detailing the design, application, resistance mechanisms, and paradoxical addiction associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe antibody-based therapeutics targeting cell-surface antigens, covering both unconjugated antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates delivering cytotoxic payloads.

topics.label: Cancer immune surveillance and immune checkpoint inhibition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the evidence for immune surveillance against tumors and the application of immune checkpoint inhibitors to reinvigorate antitumor T-cell responses against neoantigens.

topics.label: Engineered T-cell immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss advanced immunotherapies that redirect or genetically reprogram T cells to target cancer cells, focusing on bispecific T-cell engagers and chimeric antigen receptor T cells.

topics.label: Challenges, progress, and future directions in cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the broader clinical landscape of oncology, discussing systemic therapeutic challenges, historical survival trends, future treatment strategies, and clinical dilemmas.
